scope: Offline review of root-collected exact phone artifacts; no ADB/radio commands executed by this agent

evidence: semuwb-service.jar contains SR200T device type and NXP UCI classes

aoa16: interleaving only; generic mask does not advertise azimuth/elevation
mask_interpretation.caution: Apple Legacy_BPRF packet-family0/profile-index4 is not proved equivalent to FiRa BPRF set4. Profile/table numbers must be mapped from actual parameters.

verified_calls: sendUciMessage enforces permission and checks UWB enabled
vendor wrapper sends on worker executor through platform UwbManager and returns UciWaitObj payload
callbacks: registerSecUwbCallback replaces shared session callback; avoid for initial probe
registerTimesyncCallback delegates to UwbManager with MAC/type; do not assume passive or permission-complete
samsung_vendor_interface.runtime_access: not yet measured for WSS-granted APK

permission_correction.conclusion: The Termux report overstates that an ordinary installed APK can never obtain WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS. ADB may grant this development permission to a declaring APK, subject actual device policy. This is distinct from a normal runtime permission and does not confer UWB_PRIVILEGED or BLUETOOTH_PRIVILEGED.

reviewed_minimal_transport_test.attempts: one per separately coordinated permission state
reviewed_minimal_transport_test.return_envelope: response payload only; not full UCI packet

result_parse.vendor_data: discard; never log or probe arbitrary TLVs

reviewed_minimal_transport_test.mutations: No session open/config/start/stop; no callback registration; no arbitrary vendor opcode probing

Apple PHY profile/table mapping to NXP configurable params
Apple temporary BLE LTK connection-token setup has no verified ordinary Android API equivalent
Generic angle capability mask versus Samsung private angle/fusion behavior
